title: Ald.211 HTR corpus
allowed_use: Descriptive historical comparison only; may support newly frozen v03 metrics if analysis is demonstrably independent of prior Ald.211 model development.
prohibited_use: Never use as independent validation of nomenclator, Babuini, grid or other models trained/optimized on Ald.211.
audit_basis: March package identifies Ald.211 as training corpus; later adversarial audit showed optimizer search inflation and weakened p-values.
notes: Strong example of why corpus identity and validation role must be separated.

title: Legacy Arabic Qanun/Aqrabadhin comparison
provenance_type: reported real-text corpus plus synthetic comparisons
transcription_type: tokenized digital text; provenance needs recovery
allowed_use: Candidate corpus to recover and rerun prospectively after source/edition/tokenization audit.
prohibited_use: Do not use archived match rates as current evidence; target definitions and section baselines changed and raw source provenance is not yet frozen.
audit_basis: Archived results show multiple VMS targets and mixed synthetic/real comparators, making direct inheritance unsafe.
notes: Real historical corpus may be useful; old numerical verdict is not.

title: Burchards Dekret Digital abbreviation pairs
transcription_type: paired graphemic abbreviation and expanded text
allowed_use: Direct intervention control for what expansion of genuine medieval abbreviation does to surface statistics.
prohibited_use: Chronologically remote; augmented training rows must not be used as if natural frequencies. Only original non-augmented manuscript-derived pairs are admissible.
audit_basis: Dataset documentation states five Burchard manuscripts, TEI abbreviation/expansion pairs; augmented duplicates exist for model training.
notes: Potentially powerful causal control if restricted to original manuscript sequence rather than augmentation.

title: Legacy BG42/v11 derivative comparison
allowed_use: Historical bookkeeping only.
prohibited_use: Do not cite 28/35 vs 17/35 as a formal control result without reconstructing the original source corpus and exact metric correspondence.
audit_basis: Audit found the archived document mixes a tuned v11 result with a derived BG subset and loosely describes the underlying Bowern/Gaskell programme.
notes: Underlying public Bowern/Gaskell datasets remain admissible when analysed prospectively; this derivative headline does not.

title: BAV Borg.lat.898 recovered historical cipher
date_scope: early modern; exact dating/provenance retained from source audit rather than used as Voynich-period match
genre_scope: books of secrets / medical-pharmacological and technical material
provenance_type: primary DECODE transcription + independently recovered key/plaintext
transcription_type: ciphertext Unicode transcription with line markers; corrected Latin available
raw_locator: DECODE/Stockholm-Uppsala Borg.lat.898 files; prior Claude audit conversation 280fe330-b1e2-44bf-ab0e-405edccf9fbd
allowed_use: Known-mechanism real historical cipher sanity control; prior experiment established that real transcription noise and a small nomenclator/abbreviation component did not materially displace ciphertext conditional entropy from plaintext. May be extended prospectively to XD1 if raw files are reacquired.
prohibited_use: Do not cite substitution invariance as an empirical discovery or discriminating test: exact invariance under a bijection is mathematical. Do not generalize Borg to historical ciphers broadly or to verbose/homophonic systems.
audit_basis: July 2026 preregistered primary-data experiment: 92,243 retained cipher symbols and 116,048 Latin symbols; later same-session retraction explicitly demoted the invariance headline as tautological.
notes: Important retraction preserved: original “substitution invariance demonstrated rather than asserted” framing was withdrawn. Residual evidential value is a real-world robustness/sanity anchor only.

title: Bowern et al. systematic encipherment/text-manipulation corpus
allowed_use: Algorithmic control for which classes of known transformations alter entropy, length and other portable surface statistics.
prohibited_use: Not a historical cipher corpus and not evidence that any tested transformation was used in the Voynich manuscript; do not import old nearest-distance rankings as mechanism verdicts.
audit_basis: 893 comparisons across declared text manipulations; methods and corpus code publicly documented.
notes: Re-run only the portable frozen v03 projection rather than reuse Euclidean-distance conclusions.

title: Circa Instans / Wellcome MS 624 transcription corpus
date_scope: medieval witness; exact transcription campaign to verify
raw_locator: March 2026 MANIFEST: ci_corpus_parsed.pkl; associated paper2 project
allowed_use: Potential external genre control for generic text statistics once raw transcription and source contract are recovered.
prohibited_use: Cannot validate any old Circa-Instans-derived cipher/nomenclator hypothesis because it was used in tuning/model selection. Do not call it an independent validation corpus for those models.
audit_basis: March manifest and audit logs document parsed CI corpus and repeated use as validation/training proxy.
notes: Can still be scientifically useful for v03 metrics that were frozen months later and not selected using CI outcomes, subject to provenance/QC.

title: CREMMA Medii Aevi medieval Latin HTR ground truth
genre_scope: mixed; includes medical, scholastic, literary, ecclesiastical
provenance_type: manuscript ground truth + scholarly transcription project
transcription_type: ALTO XML graphematic; abbreviations/signs and manuscript spacing preserved
allowed_use: External control for physical lines, graphematic abbreviation, memory depth, token-shape carryover and recurrence; medical witnesses can be analysed separately.
prohibited_use: Do not pool centuries/genres blindly; no general writer labels; individual witness sample sizes are small.
audit_basis: Public HTR ground truth, 7274 lines, transcription guidelines preserve abbreviation signs, spaces and manuscript line structure.
notes: Select manuscripts prospectively by century/genre before computing Voynich comparisons. XD1 v2 corrected execution 6aafb64051992417dfccca87: 12 witnesses pass P1-P4 minimum gate; 7 also pass P5 >=2000-token gate. Witnesses remain separate; no pooled medieval-Latin score is licensed.

title: DECODE / DECRYPT historical cipher database
allowed_use: Discovery pool from which narrowly specified historical cipher subsets may be preregistered.
prohibited_use: The database as a whole is not a control corpus. Never pool cipher types, centuries, keys and ciphertexts; never treat presence in DECODE as admissibility.
audit_basis: Published database contains heterogeneous historical sources, many short, with varying transcription/decryption availability.
notes: A formal subset must require known mechanism, reliable transcription, adequate length, date/language metadata and preferably plaintext/key before any inference.

title: Florence Biblioteca Riccardiana MS 106 semantic clustering positive control
transcription_type: normalized lexical transcription for Jaccard semantic test
raw_locator: Voynich Archive SUPPLEMENT_CORRECTED_FINAL; Florence MS106 Transkribus work
allowed_use: Positive control for the specific semantic-clustering/Jaccard method: specialized therapeutic categories produced detectable clustering.
prohibited_use: Not admissible for v03 surface/line/abbreviation metrics because preprocessing normalized orthography, lemmatized and filtered stopwords.
audit_basis: 56 entries, permutation test with category-size-preserving null; two categories survived Bonferroni in archived supplement.
notes: Retain as method-sensitivity evidence, not as a general surface-production control.

title: Gaskell–Bowern human-produced meaningless text
allowed_use: Human-production control for whether instructed asemantic writing can generate low-level Voynich-like statistics; analyse pre-Voynich-aware and public participants separately where possible.
prohibited_use: Not historical evidence; short 1–3 page samples cannot test manuscript-scale page/quire dynamics; do not infer medieval production from similarity.
audit_basis: Published protocol, 42 volunteers plus authors, anonymized transcriptions and statistical outputs public; contamination sensitivity discussed in paper.
notes: One of the few actual human mechanism experiments and therefore more informative than many synthetic generators. Public repo metadata lists 45 rows (42 volunteers + 3 author samples per paper), but gibberish_transcriptions.zip contains 38 text files; missing metadata IDs DA_03, DC_02, DC_07, DC_13, DC_14, DC_17, DC_19. XD1 formal runs therefore refer only to the recoverable 38-file subset. Non-specialist stratum: 20 participants/48 page blocks/4,874 tokens; specialist stratum: 14 participants/30 page blocks/4,176 tokens; unknown stratum: 4 participants/10 page blocks/1,025 tokens.

title: Synthetic Chinese JCZS formulary generator
allowed_use: Historical record of hypothesis exploration only.
prohibited_use: No external-control inference. v2 plan explicitly proposed scaling vocabulary, topic structure and corpus size to repair failed Voynich metrics.
audit_basis: Archived handoff documents 98-formula v1 and a planned VMS-scale synthetic v2 designed to close specific metric gaps.
notes: Useful only as an example of how easy it is to tune a mechanism toward the target.

title: Legacy S6/S6a language discrimination battery
provenance_type: real corpora passed through proposed Babuini/grid mapping
allowed_use: Historical record of tested language corpora; possible source list for future independent controls.
prohibited_use: Do not use rankings, kills or source-language conclusions in v03 inference: the measurement map presupposes the obsolete/provisional Babuini-grid mechanism.
audit_basis: Archived battery explicitly maps source consonants into proposed cipher rows; result therefore depends on the mechanism under test.
notes: Recover underlying corpora if useful, but rerun from raw text with frozen portable metrics.

title: Nuremberg Letterbooks 2–5
transcription_type: PAGE XML basic/diplomatic/regularized; expanded and unexpanded abbreviation variants
allowed_use: Primary external control for physical-line attenuation, writer effects, abbreviation intervention, token-shape carryover and recurrence in contemporaneous professional scribal text.
prohibited_use: Not a medical/technical genre match; cannot by itself distinguish semantic from asemantic production.
audit_basis: 1711 labelled pages, approximately 50k annotated lines, 10 writer IDs, diplomatic and regularized alternatives, published technical validation.
notes: Highest-priority new external corpus because physical lines, writers and abbreviation intervention are all observed. Ingest sanity check reproduced the published 48,322 diplomatic lines exactly; 1,637 physical image pages reconstructed; source SHA256 59e5264a... Corrected XD1 v2 P2/P5 completed after numeric-order and segment-boundary regression fix. P2 job 6aafb6be51992417dfccca90; P5 job 6aafb6c252d0dbd7f1d73a5d. Unexpanded and expanded representations agree in sign/profile.

title: Nuremberg Letterbooks 6–14
transcription_type: TEI XML automatic transcription with abbreviation/deletion tags
allowed_use: Large near-exact-period extension for discovery, power analysis and replication after explicit QC against scans.
prohibited_use: Not admissible for fine-grained quantitative inference until a predeclared QC sample establishes transcription error bounds; project states transcriptions are unverified.
audit_basis: Dataset creators explicitly state automatic transcriptions are unverified and intended as a navigation aid.
notes: Use only after QC; do not pool with verified books 2–5 as if equivalent.

title: P70C / 84-metric generator hierarchy
allowed_use: Ablation/stress-test of whether specified mechanisms can reproduce known VMS measurements.
prohibited_use: Never use as an independent external control or as evidence that a historical mechanism existed.
audit_basis: Generator architecture, tolerances and parameters were explicitly developed from Voynich observations.
notes: Retain as engineering falsifier, not corpus evidence.

title: PeDoCo Penitentiary Document Corpus
provenance_type: TEI corpus converted from scholarly editions
allowed_use: Control for highly formulaic professional Latin, lexical recurrence and repertoire concentration.
prohibited_use: Not a physical-line manuscript control; cannot support SPACE-vs-LINE_BREAK, hand effects, or abbreviation-as-written claims without manuscript images/transcriptions.
audit_basis: Project description documents conversion from editions, formulaic abbreviation practices, TEI structure and 1410-1531 date range.
notes: Useful precisely because it separates formulaicity from physical manuscript production.

title: Pseudo-Apuleius Herbarius fragment null
allowed_use: Hypothesis-generation or preliminary null checks only.
prohibited_use: No formal inference: archive explicitly states fragments are incomplete and assembled from web search results rather than a complete critical text.
audit_basis: Archived control document states incomplete fragments and recommends obtaining full Howald–Sigerist or equivalent edition.
notes: Replace with a complete edition/transcription before formal use.

title: SG1.1 four-work Middle Dutch multi-witness control
allowed_use: Positive control for whether the frozen source-bearing instrument can recover genuinely shared source units across held-out witnesses.
prohibited_use: Not a genre match to Voynich; not evidence for any Voynich source language, cipher or production mechanism.
audit_basis: Frozen SG1.1 Phase1B control, held-out witness validation, lexical and opaque256 representations, 4/4 works resolved.
notes: This is already Fortune-grade control evidence and should remain part of the formal evidence chain.

title: Tacuinum / Regimen Sanitatis seasonal-row controls
provenance_type: historical source material analysed for a specific zodiac-row hypothesis
allowed_use: Evidence for the narrow tested proposition that actual Tacuinum entries and Regimen de Mensibus vocabulary do not reproduce the proposed VMS seasonal consonant-row flip.
prohibited_use: Not a general v03 control and not evidence about all regimen or pharmaceutical traditions.
audit_basis: Archive records correction from cherry-picked initial test to actual entries and a fair Regimen de Mensibus test with wrong-direction/flat result.
notes: Keep the negative result; do not generalize beyond its frozen hypothesis.

title: Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang proposed real-text control
allowed_use: Candidate real-text cross-cultural formulary control if a verified edition and frozen tokenization are obtained.
prohibited_use: Do not cite planned expectations or comparison outcomes; archived document is a task specification, not a result.
audit_basis: Handoff explicitly says test was in progress and requires downloading/verifying full text and testing multiple tokenizations.
notes: Potential future control, but it must be restarted from primary data.

title: Timm/Schinner self-citation mechanism
raw_locator: Timm & Schinner publications; archived local tests
allowed_use: Prospective mechanism comparator if the authors’ faithful algorithm/code is recovered and run without local reinterpretation.
prohibited_use: Do not use the old local approximate self-citation implementation as a definitive falsification of Timm; it was not a clean independent reproduction.
audit_basis: Archived S5 explicitly describes a locally implemented pure self-citation generator; later Theory Compiler separately killed the faithful sequential adjacent copy-mutate complete model class tested there.
notes: Keep external publication and our local approximations distinct.

title: Legacy v11 Babuini/nomenclator forward model
allowed_use: Historical record and source of falsifiable subclaims already audited elsewhere.
prohibited_use: Not an independent control for v03 and not evidence of a cipher mechanism. Do not carry forward old headline scores.

notes: Preserve provenance, not authority.
